panels.title: Read this before drawing a conclusion

options.content:
**The hint comparison below is confounded.** `was_holdout` is 0 on all 330 rows as of 2026-08-10, so there is no control arm — hints are injected where failures already cluster, which biases the comparison against them. Treat the split as a prompt to investigate, not as a measurement of whether hints help.

**This dashboard cannot be filtered by org.** `learning_metrics` and `trigger_events` have no `org_id` column.

panels.title: Pass rate with and without injected hints
panels.description:
hint_tokens and llm_cost are NOT populated: both are wired to a literal zero on all 330 rows, including the 90 that did inject hints (hints_available up to 19), so they are dropped from this panel rather than shipped as an always-zero column. The learning path's real token and dollar spend is visible only in the panel below, via trigger_events.

Coverage: 109 of 123 execution records join to neither workflow_metrics nor test_runs, and 312 of 330 learning_metrics rows have no metrics row. Neither dashboard joins those tables away — each counts its own spine — so those rows are in the numbers above. They are real runs, not pollution: the 109 cover 30 distinct queries across 9 domains with 62 passes, spanning 2026-02-23 to 2026-07-15; the 312 cover 30 distinct queries with 189 passes, spanning 2026-02-28 to 2026-07-15. What they blend is engine eras. The default now-1y window admits all of them, so narrowing the time picker is a deliberate act, not a floor this dashboard applies for you.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN hints_injected > 0 THEN 'hints injected' ELSE 'no hints' END AS arm, count(*) AS runs, round(avg(test_passed)::numeric, 3) AS pass_rate FROM learning_metrics WHERE (timestamp::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hint availability against injection
panels.description: hints_available is what the retriever found; hints_injected is what reached the prompt.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs, round(avg(hints_available)::numeric, 2) AS avg_available, round(avg(hints_injected)::numeric, 2) AS avg_injected, count(*) FILTER (WHERE hints_available > 0 AND hints_injected = 0) AS available_but_not_injected, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_retry_after_feedback = 1) AS retries_after_feedback FROM learning_metrics WHERE (timestamp::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Hint lifecycle
panels.description: 36 rows as of 2026-08-10 — 21 active, 15 disabled, 0 conflict_flagged. The 'flagged' arm is correct but currently unreachable; do not read this dashboard as evidence there are no flagged hints today. All-time by design: a snapshot of the hint set as it stands now, so the time picker does not move it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_active = 0 THEN 'disabled' WHEN conflict_flagged = 1 THEN 'flagged' ELSE 'active' END AS state, count(*) AS hints, sum(applied_count) AS applied, sum(success_count) AS successes, sum(failure_count) AS failures, sum(unused_count) AS unused FROM nl_feedback_corrections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY hints DESC

panels.title: Hints that are earning their place
panels.description: A hint applied many times with few successes is a candidate for disabling. All-time by design: a snapshot of the hint set as it stands now, so the time picker does not move it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, domain, scope, category, applied_count, success_count, failure_count, unused_count, round(100.0 * success_count / nullif(applied_count, 0), 1) AS success_pct, feedback_text FROM nl_feedback_corrections WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY applied_count DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Learning-path LLM calls, and how often they fail
panels.description: This spend is NOT in workflow_metrics.total_cost, which is crewai plus browser-use only. As of 2026-08-10, 4 of 16 LLM-invoking triggers failed, one of them burning 16,313 completion tokens on a parse failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trigger_type, status, count(*) AS events, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, round(avg(llm_latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms FROM trigger_events WHERE created_at::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Runs that proceeded with learning disabled
panels.description: optimization_fallback_used marks a run where learning init failed and generation continued without hints. Silent degradation. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (data->>'optimization_fallback_used')::boolean) AS fallback_runs, count(*) AS total_runs FROM workflow_metrics WHERE data ? 'optimization_fallback_used'

panels.title: Model output that needed cleaning or retrying
panels.description: empty_response_failures is a silent model failure the run recovered from, or did not. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs, sum((data->'llm_cleaning_stats'->>'formatting_errors_detected')::int) AS formatting_errors, sum((data->'llm_cleaning_stats'->>'formatting_errors_recovered')::int) AS formatting_recovered, sum((data->'llm_cleaning_stats'->>'empty_response_retries')::int) AS empty_retries, sum((data->'llm_cleaning_stats'->>'empty_response_failures')::int) AS empty_failures FROM workflow_metrics WHERE data ? 'llm_cleaning_stats'
